description:
Free soundboard for Discord and games, with a voice changer, text-to-speech and screen triggers.

Onion Board plays sounds through your mic into Discord and games. Global hotkeys and an in-game overlay work while you play.
It includes a live voice changer, text-to-speech, per-sound effects, YouTube / SoundCloud search to add sounds, internet radio, and sending another program's audio.
Screen triggers play a sound automatically when a picture shows up on screen, such as a game's death screen.
Sounds go straight into the mic you already use, so Discord and games hear them with nothing to change there. A free virtual cable (VB-Cable) is still supported as another way.
